newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece to cut basic depo rate 30bps Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece to cut basic depo rate 30bps Aug 18.

text.p: The Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, said in a statement that it would slash its basic deposit facility rate by 30 basis points to 11.30 percent, effective August 18, leaving its floor depo rate unchanged at 9.60 percent.

The Bank of Greece introduced its two-tier depo facility on March 28, 1997. A total of 300 billion drachmas from all credit institutions operating in Greece is absorbed at the basic rate and amounts in excess of 300 billion at the floor rate.
On July 25, 1997 the central bank cut by 30 basis point its basic and floor depo facility rates to 11.6 and 9.6 percent respectively. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
